clips.title: The story
paras: Rau Cliffrunner is a tauren scout and scholar stationed high atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Dedicated to protecting his people from regional threats, he studies the history and origins of the hostile Galak centaur through their ancient relics. Working closely with allies in Thunder Bluff, Rau coordinates ventures into dangerous enemy strongholds across the canyon.

Perched on the perilous bluffs of Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner maintains a watchful eye over the sweeping, sun-scorched expanse of Thousand Needles. The tauren outpost serves as a crucial Horde sanctuary in an otherwise hostile territory teeming with ferocious predators, quilboar, and aggressive centaur clans. Rau acts as both an outpost organizer and a dedicated investigator, keen on neutralizing emerging threats before they can overwhelm the vulnerable mesa settlements.
